catepuch: k'atepuch — then also; cate 'then' + puch 'also' written as one word
xe: xe — they; x- completive + e 'they', before an intransitive verb (xe na'ojinik 'they pondered'); also xe' 'root' in the title line · xe' — the foot, the bottom of (a tree, a mountain, a ravine); xe' 'root, foot', before the noun · xe — x- completive + e 'them', the object before a transitive verb (inferred; mi xe a calaba 'have you ruined them')
zuanic: suanik — fluting, playing the flute; su 'flute' made a verb + -ik

ri: ri — the, that (definite article/relative marker, e.g. ri Tepew 'the Sovereign'); particle

puch: puch — also, and; particle tagging the second of a pair
catit: qatit — our grandmother; qa- 'our' + atit 'grandmother' · katit — their grandmother; k- (ki- 'their' before a vowel) + atit 'grandmother', in the narrative (ruk' katit 'to their grandmother')
cuꜭ: kuk' — with them; ruk' 'with him' with 3pl prefix · quk' — with us; q- 'our' (qa- before a vowel) + uk' 'company'

xu: xu — it (did); x- completive + u- 'it', singular of xki
hunahpu: Junajpu — Hunahpu; name, also a day in the calendar; meaning uncertain · Junajpu — also the name of a mountain (Brasseur: the Volcán de Fuego)
coy: k'oy — monkey; noun, written with plain c (the house word is ꜭoy)
vbi: ub'i' — its name, called; u- 'its' + b'i' 'name', possessed noun
oc: oq — yet, still; adverb of continuing state · ok — enter; verb (que rah oc pa hul 'they want to enter a hollow') · -oq — ending after a verb of motion marking the direction, written apart (apon oq 'arrive there')
cu: k'u — then, so; narrative connective, variant of k'ut · ku — k- 'ongoing' + u- 'he', written cu like the particle (cu nimarizah rib 'he makes himself great')
vloc: uloq — hither, this way; adverb with verbs of coming

vlic: ulik — arrived here; ul 'arrive here' + -ik, ending at the end of a clause
atit: atit — grandmother; noun (also in Ratit) · atit — old woman; noun
vach: wach — face (also eye, fruit); noun, root of uwach (ki wach 'their face')
xril: xril — he saw it, she saw it; x- completive + r- 'he, she' (the form before a vowel) + il 'see'
xꜩeenic: xtze'nik — laugh, laughing; x- (perhaps ix 'you (pl.)' run into mi, Brasseur m'yx-tzeenic; inferred) + tze'n 'laugh' (tze' 'laughter' + -n) + -ik (mi xtze'nik 'do not laugh')
maui: mawi — not, no; negative particle, before a noun or verb

xebec: xeb'ek — they went; x- completive + e 'they' + b'e 'go' + -k (written c), the ending of an intransitive verb
xil: xil — he saw; x- completive + il 'see', with no prefix for 'he' written

xebe: xeb'e — they went; x- completive + e 'they' + b'e 'go'
quechelah: k'echelaj — forest; a second spelling of quichelah (k'iche'laj): k'iche' 'many trees' + -laj
naquipa: naqipa — what; naqi 'what' + pa, in naquipa rumal 'why, for what reason'
bano: b'ano — do, make; b'an 'do, make' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb (xki b'ano 'they made it')
xchi: xchi — shall; the future prefix xchi-, written apart before the person prefix and the verb
ca: qa — we, our; qa- 'our' or 'we' before a verb · ka — (uncertain) in que ka k'o, 'there will yet be'; k- 'ongoing' + a · ka — k- 'ongoing' before a verb or state word, written apart (ka pichipoj '(they) are pichipoj', uncertain; ma ka jisaj, k- + a- 'you') · ka — second (inferred); kab' 'second' written without its b', as uka 'a second (pit)' · ka — (unclear) a particle before a verb or a word of state, left unrendered
chic: chik — now, already, also; adverb of changed state · chik — any more (mawi xki nataj chik 'they no longer remembered'); in their turn, also
xque: xke — (inferred) they shall; x- future + ke 'they', before a verb
ziquih: sik'ij — call; verb (modern sik'ij), compare sik'in
xeꜭha: xech'a — they spoke; x- completive + e- 'they' + ch'a(w) 'speak'
xbalanque: Xb'alanke — Xbalanque; name of the second of the two boys, with Hunahpu; make-up uncertain (Brasseur: x- diminutive + balam 'jaguar')
cate: k'ate — then, only then; narrative particle
vl: ul — come, arrive here; verb, the root of kul and chul
ꜩe: tze' — laughter, laugh; noun (the modern word for laughing)
libahchi: lib'ajchi — (inferred) quickly, in an instant; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur ('en un moment')
e: e — they; plural marker before a noun or verb · e — tooth, teeth; noun (also in we 'my teeth', re 'his teeth')
pam: pam — belly, womb, inside; noun (cha pam 'in your belly', ꜭo chi nu pam 'in my belly')
he: je — (inferred) go; a form of the verb 'go', after Brasseur, read with ho 'we go' and hix 'you go'; the person is unclear · je' — tail; noun (qui he 'their tails'), not the he 'go'
ꜭux: k'u'x — heart; noun (ki k'u'x 'their heart'); root of Uk'u'x
are: are — this is, it is; demonstrative/copula pointing forward
cut: k'ut — then, and so; narrative connective particle
chu: chu — at, by its (before a noun); let it (before a verb); chi 'at' + u- 'its' (chu jutaq chob'il 'by each division'), or ch- 'let' + u- 'it' (chu riqo 'let it find') · chu — he, it, before a verb; ch- + u- 'he', without the sense 'let' (chu maijaj 'he marvels')
tac: taq — plural marker 'various, several'; particle placed before a noun
huiub: juyub' — mountain; noun, huyub written with i for y
xere: xere — just so, this is how, only this; adverb
va: wa — this; demonstrative · wa — food, the maize tortilla (ca va 'our food', modern wa)
xꜭha: xch'a — said; x- completive + ch'a 'say', the singular of xech'a
acan: aq'an — climb; verb (que rah acan 'they want to climb')
ꜩac: tzaq — fall; verb (que ꜩac vloc 'they fell down') · tzaq — drop, let fall; with qa- 'we', transitive · tzaq — (uncertain) in jun tzaq, jun b'it 'one tzaq, one shaped', echoing winaq tz'aq, winaq b'it; respelled as written
chique: chike — to them; chi 'to' + ke 'them' · chiqe — to us (inside speech); chi + qe 'us' (Ximénez's qu stands for both k and q; the toggle shows chiqe) · chike — (guess) a verb after xe, 'leaned (?)', in xe chique chuvi 'they leaned (?) over it'; not clear; Brasseur 'se tournèrent … vers le parfum'
chicut: chik'ut — again then, one more then; chik 'again' + k'ut 'then' written as one word, the c shared
ma: ma — not, nor, or (in a question); negative/interrogative particle
rumal: rumal — by, because of, through; relational noun r- 'its' + umal 'cause, agent'
vi: wi — there, here, in it; locative particle (points back to a place or time) · wi' — head, top (pa ki wi' 'on their heads') · wi — part of wikiq'ab' 'right (hand)' (inferred), written apart (vi qui cab, set against mox 'left')
pixabah: pixab'aj — (inferred) charge, counsel; pixab' 'counsel, command' + -aj; used with kan to 'leave a charge behind'
vbic: ub'ik — thither (inferred); an adverb of direction, with ok 'enter'
macu: mak'u — but not, not then; ma 'not' + k'u 'then', written as one word
chire: chire — to him, to her; chi + r- 'him/her' + e · chire — at his teeth (inferred); chi + r- 'his' + e 'tooth' · chire — because, for; conjunction (chire lib'ajchi 'because quickly')
mi: mi — now, just now; particle, as mi- in mixutzinik · mi — (inferred) do not, before a verb (mi xb'isonik 'do not grieve', after Brasseur 'ne vous affligez pas'); the form is not clear
xca: xqa — we (did it); x- completive + qa- 'we', subject of a transitive verb
pu: pu — also, and; short form of puch · pu — in, at (inferred); pa 'in', in pu chi' 'in the mouth' · pu — in its, in the; pa 'in' + u- 'its' contracted (Brasseur: pu for pa u, p'u 'dans le'), as pu b'eal 'by the road', pu wi' ja 'in the top of the house'
ꜭolic: k'olik — existing, being there; k'ol + -ik, positional/participle
coh: koj — we, us (shall); k- 'shall' + oj 'we, us', before a verb (koj isik'ij 'you shall call on us') · koj — we, us (ongoing); k- 'ongoing' + oj 'we, us' (coh icuxih 'you chased us') · koj — put, place; transitive verb (inferred)
nabax: nab'ax — be remembered (uncertain); inferred (Brasseur 'commemorated'), pair of sik'ixoq
caꜩ: qatz — our elder brothers (in the speech of the younger); qa- 'our' (q- before a vowel) + atz 'elder brother'; the partner of chaq' 'younger brother' · katz — their elder brothers (in the narrative); k- (ki- 'their' before a vowel) + atz 'elder brother'
chuxoc: chuxoq — let it be; ch- optative + ux 'become' + -oq
vꜭhaxic: uch'axik — its being told, being spoken to; u- 'its' + ch'a(w) 'speak' + passive -x + -ik · uch'axik — being called (kix uch'axik 'you shall be called')
ahcot: ajkot — carver; aj- 'one who' + kot 'carve'; the plain k is kept (Brasseur's q suggests k'ot, undecided)
vxic: uxik — becoming, coming to be; ux 'become' + -ik (xe uxik 'they came to be') · uxik — (uncertain) finery, precious stones (Brasseur 'pierreries'), or perhaps xik' 'wing'; paired with vpuvac 'his silver' · uxik — (inferred) its wings; u- 'its' + xik 'wing' (modern xik'), after Brasseur ('des ailes'); the letters respelled, the ejective not restored
nimarizah: nimarisaj — make great; nim 'great' + causative -arisaj (nimarizah rib 'make oneself great, boast')
quib: kib' — themselves, one another; ki- 'their' + -ib' reflexive · qib' — ourselves; q- 'our' (qa- before a vowel) + ib' reflexive
xqui: xki — they (did it); x- completive + ki- 3pl ergative, prefix before a transitive verb · xki — you (pl.) (doubtful); in xqui zachic, xqui ca cup, as the parallel with quix camic requires; printed as written
yoc: yok — break up (uncertain); verb, sense inferred
chac: chak — (inferred) beat, defeat; after Brasseur ('afin que nous les vainquions'); the modern verb 'win' is ch'ak, but the word is uncertain and the ejective is not restored · chaq' — younger brother; noun (qui chac 'their younger brothers'), the partner of qatz 'elder brother'
zachic: sachik — loss, undoing; sach 'be lost' + -ik, verbal noun
co: k'o — there is; existential verb (written co in k'o wi lo)
cochoch: kochoch — their homes; ki- 'their' (k- before a vowel) + ochoch 'home' · qochoch — our home; qa- 'our' (q- before a vowel) + ochoch 'home'
nim: nim — great, big; adjective · nim — (inferred) respect, honour; nim 'great' made a noun or verb, in ki nim 'their respect'
ruꜭ: ruk' — with him/it; relational noun r- 'its/his' + uk' 'company'
ratit: Ratit — its grandmother; r- 'its' + atit 'grandmother'; in Ratit Q'ij, Ratit Saq · ratit — (doubtful reading) the grandmother, his grandmother; r- 'his, her' + atit 'grandmother' (rumal ri ratit 'by the grandmother')
tiquiba: tikib'a' — plant, begin (inferred; 'planting the day' taken as laying out the count of days); verb, as in xchiqatikib'a' in the preamble
chuvach: chuwach — on the face of; chi + u- 'its' + wach 'face', relational noun
xbizonic: xb'isonik — (inferred) worry, grieve; b'ison 'grieve, worry' + -ik, with x- before it unclear; the form is not certain
cam: k'am — take; verb · kam — die; verb
vvb: uub' — his blowgun; u- 'his' + ub' 'blowgun' · wub' — blowgun, after qa/ki (qa wub' 'our blowgun', ki wub' 'their blowgun'); the vv respelled wu, as iwub'aj; whether the v is a glide is not clear
teleh: telej — carry on the shoulder; verb of teleb'a
el: el — go out; verb (kat el 'you go out')
na: na — now, then; particle · na — still; particle · na — feeling, sense (inferred); na 'feel', the root of nao · na — (inferred) first, for the time being; as in oh na 'we first'
ꜫih: q'ij — day, sun; noun (Ratit Q'ij 'Grandmother of the Day'); in ki q'ij 'their day' perhaps 'their lot, fortune' (uncertain)
be: b'e — road, path; noun · b'e — go (chi b'e 'that we go'); verb, the root of xb'e 'he went'
ya: ya — give; verb (ku ya 'he gives') · ya — river, water (inferred, after Brasseur); noun, the letters respelled as written · ya — put, set; the 'give' verb used of placing a thing (qui ya 'they put it', chi ya chuvi ꜫaꜫ 'put it on the fire')
bala: b'ala — unexplained (Brasseur 'at their ease'); uncertain · b'ala — here 'very well' after utz (Utz b'ala 'very well', after Brasseur 'C'est fort bien'); inferred · b'ala — (inferred) indeed; strengthens the word before it (qitzij b'ala 'truly indeed')
catecut: k'atek'ut — then; k'ate 'then' + k'ut written as one word
opon: opon — arrive (there); verb, arriving at a place away from the speaker (ul is 'arrive here')
xaqui: xaki — (inferred) simply, merely; xa 'only' + qui, after Brasseur (xaki 'seul'); adverb
vleu: ulew — earth, land; noun; u- here part of the word, not 'its'
tahin: tajin — be at it, busy; the progressive tajin 'in the act of', here ka tajin 'he is at it'
curi: k'uri — then, and so; k'u 'then' + ri, narrative connective
cab: q'ab' — hand, arm; noun, the same word as q'ab' written with plain c · kab' — second; kab' 'two', in u kab' 'its second' (v cab, written apart), as in the ordinal ukab' · kab' — two, a pair; in u kab' 'the two of them' (v cab, written apart), after Brasseur (inferred)
rib: rib' — itself; reflexive noun r- 'its' + ib' 'self'
bec: b'ek — go; b'e 'go' with -ek (inferred), as in kat b'ek 'you go'
ronohel: ronojel — all, everything; quantifier, r- + onojel
caam: k'a'm — vine, creeper; noun, paired with che' 'tree'
ban: b'an — do, make; root of the verb, here with x- completive and ki- 3pl: 'they did'
huna: juna — (unclear) not clear, perhaps a word before re la; sense inferred from Brasseur ('there is down there')
chuvi: chuwi' — on top of; chi + u- 'its' + wi' 'head, top', relational noun · chuwi' — (inferred) after, later (of time), in ka chuwi' chik 'later on'; after Brasseur ('ensuite de cela')
petic: petik — coming; pet 'come' + -ik, verbal noun (ki petik 'their coming', qui- 'their')
cat: kat — you (one) shall; k- 'shall' + at 'you', singular of kix · kat — you (one), of what is going on; k- 'ongoing' + at 'you' (kat b'e 'you are going') · kat — (inferred) then, so; taken as k'ut written cat (keje' kat 'so then', Brasseur quehecut), the letters respelled · k'at — burn; verb (xk'at 'it burned'), the root of k'atanalaj 'burning hot'; not kat 'you (one)' · kat — carrying net (Brasseur 'filet'); noun, written with plain c, the same letters as kat 'you'
petoc: petoq — come; pet 'come' + -oq, after kix 'you (pl.)' in a command
vvbanic: wub'anik — blowgunning; the noun of wub'aj + -ik, in ki wub'anik 'their blowgunning'
mana: mana — not; negative, a form of ma
choc: chok — let it enter; ch- (wish) + ok 'enter' · chok — it enters, comes over (in narrative, not a wish); ch- + ok 'enter', as chu- in chuch'axik
chapo: chapo — catch it; chap 'catch' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb
la: la — unexplained particle in kat kix la uloq; uncertain · la — you, Your Lordship, a respectful form (chi la 'to you'; inferred from Brasseur's note); particle
vvach: uwach — its face; u- 'its' + wach 'face, surface', possessed noun · uwach — its fruit (the face a tree shows); noun

vaic: waik — eating; wa 'eat' + -ik (ta quix vaic 'while you ate')

queꜭha: kech'a — their food; the same word as quecha, written with ꜭh; ki- 'their' + echa
oponic: oponik — arrived there; opon 'arrive there' + -ik, the ending of an intransitive verb (xe oponik pa … 'they arrived in …')
cacan: kaqan — their legs, their feet; k- (ki- 'their' before a vowel) + aqan 'leg, foot'
ꜫab: q'ab' — hand, arm; noun (ki q'ab' 'their hands')
cabix: kab'ix — their field; ki- 'their' (c- before a vowel) + ab'ix · qab'ix — our field; qa- 'our' + ab'ix, the same letters
quiz: k'is — finish, end; verb (xki k'is 'they finished')
vtiu: Utiw — Coyote; name element, in Junajpu Utiw 'Hunahpu Coyote' (u- here part of the name; tiw 'coyote'?)
